test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 24 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A man P purchased a land for ₹4,32,000 on the outskirts of a city. Due to some reason, its value depreciated at 25% per annum and he sold it to Q after 2 years. At this time, the city expanded and new projects of infrastructures started coming up. As a result of the expansion, there was an appreciation of real estate prices at the rate of 50%. What would be the value (in ₹) of the land after 2 years, from the time Q bought the land from P?
solution:
**Given:**

P purchased a land for ₹4,32,000 on the outskirts of a city.

Its value depreciated at 25% per annum and he sold it to Q after 2 years.

Appreciation of real estate prices at the rate of 50%

**Concept used:**

Amount = P (1 + R/100)T 

Amount = P (1 - R/100)T 

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

P sold the lamd to Q = 432000(1 - 25%)² 

⇒ SP = 432000 (1 - 0.25)2 

⇒ SP = 432000 (0.75)2 

⇒ SP = 432000 × 0.5625 = 243000

P sold land to Q for Rs. 243000

Now the value of land after 2 years 

Amount = 243000 (1 + 0.5)2 

⇒ A = 243000 (1.5)2 

⇒ A = 243000 × 2.25 = 546750

**∴ The value (in ₹) of the land after 2 years, from the time Q bought the land from P is Rs. 546750.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

The Land's value depreciated at 25%, So after 2 year,

The value from 4² = 16 unit becomes 3³ = 9 unit

So, after two years of depreciation, the value of the land is

⇒ (432000/16) × 9 = 243000

Next two years the land's value appreciation is 50%, after 2 years

The value from 22 = 4 unit becomes 33 = 9 unit

So, after two years of appreciation, the value of the land is,

⇒ 243000/4 × 9 = 546750

**∴ The correct answer is 546750**
